channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ben Wallace | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ben Wallace from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Luka Garza on Ben Wallace
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Luka Garza on interactions with Ben Wallace:

“It's been unreal. Just being around him for me -- and any basketball fan -- is tremendous ... he's definitely somebody I look up to.”

Luka Garza on Ben Wallace, Oct 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart on Ben Wallace
item.description:
#PistonsIsaiah Stewart on connection to Ben Wallace:

“Hearing he's going to be around more, I look forward to picking his brain.”

Isaiah Stewart on Ben Wallace, Sep 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Ben Wallace
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey on Ben Wallace:

“I think it's great. It's great for our organization, it's great for Ben.”

Dwane Casey on Ben Wallace, May 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Isiah Thomas on Ben Wallace
item.description:
“Every Piston is a Hall of Famer! I mean, if real is real, right? You look at what the Pistons championship teams have done, who we are and the sacrifices that we made to be the best team. If you’re talking about rewarding teams and you’re talking about rewarding individuals for being champions, then you’re talking about Ben Wallace, Bill Lambeer – both of them are Hall of Famers.”

Isiah Thomas on Ben Wallace, Oct 31, 2020. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Ben Wallace, Kevin Johnson
item.description:
Stan Van Gundy told Yahoo Sports.

“There’s a few guys who haven’t gotten in yet but will get in … but the only guys who haven’t gotten in are Tim, Ben Wallace and Kevin Johnson. Five times, All-NBA?Top 15 in the NBA and for Tim, top 10? That’s really high-level stuff. That’s being the best of the best for long periods of time and that’s generally what they look at. How were you in your era?”

Stan Van Gundy on Ben Wallace, Kevin Johnson, Apr 3, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Ben Wallace
item.description:
Except for one DNP-coach's decision Feb. 3 against the Bucks, Wallace has answered the call every night.

“Probably if you asked (Wallace), he would probably say 'I wish he played me more,'”

Lawrence Frank on Ben Wallace, Apr 5, 2012. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Ben Wallace
item.description:
“Who knows in terms of the voting? But (from my perspective), without a doubt (Wallace is in).”

Lawrence Frank on Ben Wallace, Feb 15, 2012. Source: Detroit News.
